headline: Clashes Spread To Linn Of Mercy As Northern Grinding Continues
war_summary: Combat has widened into Linn of Mercy, where Rotdust was torn by fighting during the past two hours before settling under Colonial hands. Along the fractured northern sectors, Weathered Expanse remains the war's fiercest cockpit, logging three additional base turnovers within the last two hours as Crow's Nest and Frostmarch endure uninterrupted shelling. Mooring County continues to bleed at a staggering pace, absorbing nearly eighteen hundred casualties over the past two hours despite base lines holding temporarily firm since the earlier fighting around Gravekeeper's Holdfast. To the west, Nevish Line confirmed an ownership shift at Grief Mother amidst heavy bloodletting, leaving the sector contested while Warden defenders scramble to contain the breach. In Palantine Berm, Leiri Hermanni exchanged hands repeatedly through the evening before fighting cooled into an uneasy lull, with Colonials maintaining a foothold. Across Stlican Shelf, Fort Hoarfrost remains the pivot of ongoing skirmishes, while earlier flashpoints in Stonecradle and Farranac Coast have largely fallen quiet.
